checks.derivation: The script j(t)=1[t>=0] e^(-3t/2) floor(e^t)(floor(e^t)+1-e^t) is exactly nativePositiveCompletion. k_epsilon=e^(-epsilon t)j(t) is exactly nativeDampedCompletionKernel. The proved operator norm is <605/621<1.

Set a=z+3/2,b=z+1/2. With x=e^t, the n-th cell integral equals n(n+1)[n^(-a)-(n+1)^(-a)]/a - n[n^(-b)-(n+1)^(-b)]/b. Summing n=1..N-1 gives (2/a-1/b) sum n^(-b)+(N-1)N^(-b)(1/b-1/a). Since 2b-a=z-1/2 and a-b=1, this is exactly the script formula. Integer endpoints have measure zero; the last endpoint is log N, with no omitted cell.

The source theorem gives 0<=j(t)<=e^(-t/2). At epsilon=1/8 and N=65536=2^16, the absolute complex tail is at most N^(-5/8)/(5/8)=1/640. Arb strict comparison of the upper ball against -1/200 certifies the whole physical transform real part. The script zeta evaluation is diagnostic only; it is not used to derive the finite expression or tail. Independent recomputation directly summed every cell at both128 and256 bits without any zeta call, agreed with the telescoped enclosure and independently certified the same strict negative rational bound.

For q_T(t)=exp(i gamma t)1[0,T](t), ||q_T||^2=T. With conjugate-linear first slot, <q_T,A_epsilon q_T>=integral_0^T (T-s)k_epsilon(s)exp(-i gamma s)ds. Its normalized difference from Jhat(epsilon+i gamma) has modulus at most integral_0^infty min(s/T,1) k_epsilon(s)ds <=1/[T(epsilon+1/2)^2]=64/(25T). Use the literal real even q at s=1/4096, kappa=(d^2-1/4)q, H=kappa*kappa, B=2s. Here Jhat denotes the completion Laplace transform; separately K_H(z)=integral exp(-z*u)H(u)du. Because q is nonnegative mass1 and supported in[-s,s], Q_L(i gamma)=integral q cos(gamma*u)>=1-(s gamma)^2/2>=1/2 for gamma=109/10<1/s. Thus A>0. This is NOT paperFT evaluated at i gamma; in the repository angular convention it equals paperFT H at the real frequency -gamma (also +gamma by evenness).

Let q_c(t)=q_T(t-c), F_T=H*q_c. For T>=1024>2B, F_T=A q_c on[c+B,c+T-B] and both vanish outside[c-B,c+T+B]. Their difference is supported on two end bands of total length4B and pointwise bounded by ||H||_1+A, so ||F_T-Aq_c||_2<=E=2sqrt(B)(||H||_1+A). Because c>B, F_T is causal. Real and imaginary parts retain those two moment conditions.

Write r=F_T-Aq_c. Using ||A_epsilon||<1, the energy correction has absolute value at most2A sqrt(T) E+E^2. At T>=max(1024,(2000E/A)^2), put eta=E/(A sqrt(T))<=1/2000. All constants depend only on the literal fixed source; the threshold is fixed before T.

The completion kernel is real. For F=f+i*g, Re<F,A F>=<f,A f>+<g,A g> and ||F||^2=||f||^2+||g||^2. At least one nonzero real or imaginary part therefore has quadratic quotient <=-1/1600. It does not identify this profile with the actual prime history, a selected first-birth eigenvector, or any finite CCM parity vector.
